====Lexington, KY KoD signing, 24 October 2005 - report by Robert MacCloud====
''posted at Dragonmount.com''



Another report came in from Robert MacCloud who briefly said that another customer asked Robert Jordan about his time in Saudi Arabia. Turns out that the person had mistaken him for Robert Jordan, the US Ambassador to Saudi Arabia who had been appointed by President Bush!
